review: This app was a life safer we had many problems with order routing and warehouses and fulfilment centres that used shipstation. Great support the team helped activate the app and make sure our orders are pushed to correct warehouses.

Absolute LIFE SAVER! We opened up a new facility and are going to be shipping from both locations. We needed ShipStation to route orders to the location closest to the customer's delivery address and ran into the problem that ShipStation didn't allow us to do this. Found this app, did need to reach out to the developer to get everything setup correctly. BEST customer support I have ever experienced from an app (and we have had some good ones). I sent an e-mail on a Friday, got a response that same day, and had a virtual meeting scheduled for Monday to get everything looked into. On that call, they got everything configured for us and setup to do exactly what we wanted. AMAZING!!

We ship out of multiple locations, and splitting orders is key to our fulfillment operations. ShipSync's functionality is simple and slick. Worth every penny. Helpful and highly competent support too. I'd recommend it to anyone and everyone who needs to split orders to ship out of multiple locations.

This app is amazing for managing split orders and fulfillment locations in ShipStation/Shopify.  Developer is extremely responsive and added several features for me upon request.  Connection is real-time.  As soon as you make a change in Shopify it shows up in ShipStation.

If you find yourself managing orders across multiple locations and rely on ShipStation for your shipping needs and need a solution to auto split the orders in ShipStation based on Shopify's fulfilment location, look no further – this app is an absolute game-changer. We've been using ShipSync for a while now, and it has exceeded our expectations. Setting it up in Shopify is a breeze, and it seamlessly integrates with ShipStation without disrupting your existing workflow.
 
What truly sets ShipSync apart is their outstanding support team. Whenever we needed assistance or wanted to customize the app to suit our very specific requirements, they were right there, ready to help. Their willingness to work closely with us to fine-tune the app to perfection was truly impressive.
 
So, if you're contemplating whether to make additional improvements to your order fulfillment process, don't hesitate to reach out to ShipSync. This app has not only streamlined our operations but also demonstrated a commitment to customer satisfaction that's hard to find elsewhere
